description: This source file defines provider service classes for integrations with Atlassian Jira and Confluence, including methods for OAuth authorization, token exchange, validation, search, create, and listing projects/spaces. It also includes a factory function for obtaining service instances.

classes.name: ProviderServiceBase
classes.description: Base class that provides common methods and interface for provider-specific services, handling token management and abstract operations.

classes.name: JiraConnectorService
classes.description: Service class for Atlassian Jira, implementing OAuth, search, create, and project listing.

classes.name: ConfluenceConnectorService
classes.description: Service class for Atlassian Confluence, implementing OAuth, search, create, and space listing.

methods.name: ProviderServiceBase.oauth_authorization_url
methods.description: Returns a URL for OAuth authorization flow; to be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: ProviderServiceBase.exchange_code_and_store_tokens
methods.description: Handles exchanging OAuth code for tokens and storing them; to be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: ProviderServiceBase.validate_api_key
methods.description: Validates an API key with the provider; stub in base class, more specific in subclasses.

methods.name: ProviderServiceBase.search
methods.description: Performs a search query in the provider; to be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: ProviderServiceBase.create
methods.description: Creates an object/resource in the provider; to be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: ProviderServiceBase.list_projects
methods.description: Lists projects; default implementation returns empty list.

methods.name: ProviderServiceBase.list_spaces
methods.description: Lists spaces; default implementation returns empty list.
